'''Z-Alpha Squadron''' was a [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bomber]] unit originally in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] that defected to rogue [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]]'s [[Zaarin coup forces|government]] [[Zaarin's fleet|fleet]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In what became known as the [[Zaarin insurrection]], they fought against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] but were ultimately defeated.
